title: Events
description: Shared event schemas: a CloudEvents envelope and JSONCommit, a generic description of one change to one JSON resource. Unlike v0.0.1, field names are camelCase and a transaction can carry several commits.

CloudEvent.title: CloudEvent
CloudEvent.description: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (structured mode). Only the attributes used in this lab are listed; other CloudEvents attributes and extensions are allowed.

id.description: Unique id of this event within its `source`. For an incoming transaction this is also the idempotency key.

source.description: URI reference of the system or client that produced the event.

type.description: Event type. `json.commit` for a single accepted commit, `json.commit.transaction` for an incoming transaction, or a reverse-DNS profile type for a typed transaction.

subject.description: What the event is about. For a `json.commit` event: the `resourceId` of the commit.

dataschema.description: URI of the JSON Schema that `data` conforms to. For a typed transaction: the profile the receiver validates the transaction against.

sequence.description: Position in the feed, assigned by the receiver when the event is recorded.

transactionid.description: CloudEvents extension attribute: id of the transaction this commit was part of. All events from one transaction carry the same value, so a consumer can apply them together. Lowercase because CloudEvents extension names must be lowercase alphanumeric.

data.description: The event payload: a `JSONCommit` for `json.commit`, a `CommitBatch` for a transaction.

JSONCommit.title: JSONCommit
JSONCommit.description: One change to one JSON resource. Exactly one of `resourceData` (create or replace), `patch` (update) or `deleted: true` (delete) is present.

resourceId.description: Identity of the resource, chosen by whoever creates it (a URN or UUID). Other commits, in the same transaction or later, refer to the resource with this value.

schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema that describes the resource.

resourceData.description: The complete resource. Used to create a resource.

patch.description: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) applied to the existing resource. `null` removes a field.

actor.description: Who made the change. Set by the receiver from the authenticated identity; a value sent by a client is ignored.

timestamp.description: When the change was recorded (RFC 3339). Set by the receiver.

CommitBatch.title: CommitBatch
CommitBatch.description: The `data` of a transaction: commits that are applied in order, all or nothing.

CommitEvent.title: CommitEvent
CommitEvent.description: An accepted commit as it appears on a feed or event stream.

CommitTransaction.title: CommitTransaction
CommitTransaction.description: An incoming transaction: one CloudEvent whose `data` is a `CommitBatch`.
